title: If You Could Hear the Sun

scenes.text: The Sun is not silent. It is just too loud for the air between us to carry.
scenes.art_prompt: a sun like an enormous glowing sphere beside a tiny Earth for scale, dramatic

scenes.text: If space were filled with air, the Sun would roar at you every second of your life.
scenes.art_prompt: sound waves radiating from a star through glowing atmosphere, physics illustration

scenes.text: It would be roughly a hundred decibels - a chainsaw that never stops, day or night.
scenes.art_prompt: a city skyline under a blazing sun, invisible waves pressing on the windows

scenes.text: You would never hear a conversation, a car, or a friend again.
scenes.art_prompt: a person on a quiet street under a too-bright sky, hands over ears, surreal

scenes.text:
The silence of space is not peace.
It is the only thing standing between us and a star that never stops shouting.
scenes.art_prompt: a calm Earth from orbit with a subtle glowing field around it, resolved conclusion

scenes.text: Follow What If Physics for the next question.
scenes.art_prompt: a quiet blue Earth against a vast dark cosmos, final wide shot
